subject.title: refactor(extensions): remove orphaned shadow trial and retired config aliases

question: Should OpenClaw remove the QQBot and Feishu runtime aliases now, relying exclusively on `openclaw doctor --fix` for upgrades, after final-head CI completes?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility boundary affecting persisted user configuration; the code and live proof support the migration, but accepting the fail-closed upgrade contract is a maintainer release decision.

options.title: Confirm Doctor-only migration
options.body: Merge after final-head checks pass, keeping runtime canonical-only and directing existing installations through Doctor migration.

options.title: Retain an explicit compatibility period
options.body: Keep the legacy aliases temporarily and define a documented deprecation/removal release before tightening runtime validation.

recommendation.title: Confirm Doctor-only migration
recommendation.body: Merge after final-head checks pass, keeping runtime canonical-only and directing existing installations through Doctor migration.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned contributor authored both channel migration contracts and supplied the upgrade proof, making them the best available routing candidate for the maintainer decision.
